method length_of_intersection(interval1: (int, int), interval2: (int, int)) returns (length: int)
    requires interval1.0 <= interval1.1 // start of interval1 is less than or equal to end
    requires interval2.0 <= interval2.1 // start of interval2 is less than or equal to end
    ensures length >= 0 // length of intersection is non-negative
    ensures (length > 0 ==> (interval1.0 <= interval2.1 && interval2.0 <= interval1.1)) // length is positive if intervals intersect
    ensures (length == 0 ==> !(interval1.0 <= interval2.1 && interval2.0 <= interval1.1)) // length is zero if intervals do not intersect

method prime(n: int) returns (is_prime: bool)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures (is_prime == true ==> n > 1 && forall i: int :: 2 <= i < n ==> n % i != 0) // n is prime if is_prime is true
